newsitem.title: UK: Shell, BP up on strong oil price.
newsitem.headline: Shell, BP up on strong oil price.

text.p: Shares in British Petroleum Co Plc and Shell Transport & Trading Co Plc were marked higher in early trade on Tuesday on the back of recent strong crude oil prices and echoing gains in their ADRs in the U.S., traders said.
Shell was up 7p at 994 by 0819 GMT, extending yesterday's 19-1/2p jump, and BP was up 5p at 655-1/2.
"BP and Shell have had a bit of a shakeout and this has been overdone. The fundamentals have not changed and remain strong," said one analyst.
BP ADRs closed $2-3/4 higher at $130-5/8 and Shell ADRs gained $1-1/8 at $98-1/2 in New York last night.
Despite weakening yesterday, Brent crude gained over $1 dollar a barrel in the last two trading days of last week.
